stem: Bruno’s conclusion is weak. Which sentences should replace sentences 33 and 34 to bring this paper to a more effective conclusion?

options.label: A
options.text: So watch for opportunities to leave an online review. In the long run, you will be glad that you did.

options.label: B
options.text: Therefore, the act of leaving a review does not just benefit the business asking for it. It benefits everyone.

options.label: C
options.text: Certainly, the customers who write reviews are real people just like you and me. It is important to keep this in mind.

options.label: D
options.text: Most importantly, read the reviews before you buy a product. It can be the difference between a good and bad life decision.
